services.name: Charter KLNS
services.desc: Memberships are ideal for businesses needing to transport employees efficiently, as they provide flexible scheduling and often reduce travel time by more than half! For individuals, it offers a convenient and cost-effective way to access private travel for personal trips, with the added benefit of saving or gifting unused hours. All charter flights are operated by 5KTA152N LLC under FAA Air Carrier Certificate

gap: Duration of training courses not stated
blurb: Chester County Aviation offers comprehensive flight training programs for various pilot certifications with knowledgeable instructors and an interactive online curriculum. They provide aircraft rental for qualified pilots, on-demand charter services under FAA Part 135, and specialized maintenance including Robinson Helicopter service. They also handle aircraft sales by appointment and offer aircraft management and leaseback services.

quotes.text: I have always had a great experience here. I have had ups and downs in my aviation journey, but CCA has always been a helping hand. They always had my interests in mind, and working with me on weird schedules. They are very accommodating, and flexible. I will be continuing to give them my business when I need some more help or want to enjoy a day of flying! Go here and enjoy the time because they care!
